content.text: See all the requests your child submits here—money transfers, reward approvals, and more.
You can filter by status: Pending, Approved, Denied, or All.
Tap on a request to view full details and messages.
To approve or deny a request:
Tap Approve to accept, or Deny to reject.
Add a note to your child (optional) to explain your decision.
Your child will be notified of your response and can see your note!
